research_scope: Final Parallel Quest skills from PQ178-186, covering Future Saga Chapter 2 continuation, Future Saga Chapter 3, and Future Saga Chapter 4. Non-skill rewards excluded; exact probabilities left unresolved unless explicitly established.

verification_audit.method: Reconciled PQ numbering and reward identities against the current all-186 PQ guide and Ultimate Finish requirement references. The prior draft incorrectly attributed Super Saiyan 4 Limit Break to PQ184; the current guide identifies Chaotic Time Impact as the PQ184 skill reward. Venus Fist remains null because community reports establish RNG difficulty but do not establish that the Ultimate Finish itself is mandatory.

duplicate_screening.notes: Only skill rewards attributable to PQ178-186 are included; Super Souls, clothing, accessories, artwork, and non-skill rewards are excluded.
